environment.description: Quarkus Lambda handler deployed behind API Gateway (REST API type) configured as a PRIVATE endpoint. The API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access exclusively to requests originating from VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 in the application VPC (10.0.0.0/16). The VPC endpoint has an endpoint policy that further restricts execute-api:Invoke to IAM principals with tag 'team=internal-frontend'. There is no NAT gateway or internet gateway attached to the subnets associated with the VPC endpoint. DNS resolution for the API Gateway custom domain resolves only to the VPC endpoint's private ENI IPs via Route 53 private hosted zone. The Lambda has provisioned concurrency of 1 for session state persistence.
